verdict.rationale: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT replacement whose application and models run entirely on the user's own hardware. The repo provides a build-from-source path that installs dependencies, builds core components and launches the app. It also ships a local OpenAI-compatible server that can be exposed on the local network. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting, documented headless/server or multi-user deployment (e.g., container images).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: It comes with built-in foundation models and an application ecosystem that runs entirely on your hardware
This handles everything: installs dependencies, builds core components, and launches the app.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
`0.0.0.0`: The server is accessible from other devices on your local network (e.g., your phone or another computer).
